rules: No discovery is removed because it is weak, unresolved, contradictory or off-target.
EXCLUDE_FROM_ACQUISITION means do not auto-acquire; it does not mean delete.
Research Value and Evidence Confidence are separate non-probabilistic scores.

event_first_discovery.rule: Local context produces provisional candidates only. Names and dates are unresolved until original inspection; rejected/unresolved matches remain in context queues.

rules: Every claim must remain traceable to preserved evidence.
Supporting-source count is not equivalent to independent corroboration.
Contradictory evidence and unknowns must be recorded explicitly.
Catalogue metadata and OCR discovery context cannot by themselves establish VERIFIED.
No automated stage may mark a claim VERIFIED.
Research Value and Evidence Confidence are separate; low confidence never deletes a research lead.

verification.rule: Verification is evidence-weighted and claim-specific; no automated stage may set HUMAN_REVIEWED or VERIFIED.

execution_manifest.note: GitHub Actions retains platform logs separately; durable research evidence and file SHA-256 values are preserved under evidence/runs.

limitations: Catalogue metadata does not prove an event.
OCR/event proximity is a discovery lead only.
Blocked repositories remain explicit research gaps.
No candidate is VERIFIED without original inspection, extraction, genealogy assessment and human review.
Low Evidence Confidence never removes a finding from Research Discovery; it only limits claim use and automation.
